name: USurf File Manager
tagline: Manage and compress files, with built-in FTP support
description:
USurf File Manager is a file manager for Android that goes beyond basic browsing. It includes file compression tools (including 7-Zip support) and a built-in FTP server, so you can move files between your phone and other devices over the network.

It's a good pick if you regularly need to zip things up or transfer files without cables or cloud storage.
